The response for gamma_L = 0.4, gamma_H = 1.6, c = 1 and D_0 = 0.03, as in the figure. At frequency 0 it is gamma_L, so the mean of the log image is scaled by 0.4. Far from the center it reaches gamma_H. At D = D_0 it is gamma_L + (gamma_H - gamma_L)(1 - e^-1).
